Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[Artoo & •Threepio]]: R2-D2 on the hull of Queen Amidala's royal starship, repairing it under fire as it runs the Trade Federation blockade of Naboo in ''The Phantom Menace''.

Source: [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/File:R2_repair.png R2 repair.png], Wookieepedia (a frame from ''Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace'' (1999); 967 by 544 pixels). Reduced to 800 by 450 pixels and converted to JPEG. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170711011208/http://starwars.wikia.com/wiki/File:R2_repair.png Internet Archive], 11 July 2017.
